## 2 — Operation items

### CON-CAT-007 — Read an Item (قراءة صنف / Read an Item)
Signature : getItem(itemPk: BIGINT) → Item {itemPk, code, nameAr, nameEn, itemKindCode, baseUomCode, categoryFk, brandCode, taxClassCode, einvoiceCodeTypeCode, einvoiceCode, publishStateCode, isActiveFl; active Variants with their attribute values; Item units; barcodes; Bundle component lines (componentVariantFk, Variant code, quantity); active media} · errors: not found
Entity    : ENT-CAT-001
Traces    : ENT-CAT-001, REQ-CAT-001, REQ-CAT-002, REQ-CAT-010, REQ-CAT-058

An inactive Item is still returned, with `isActiveFl` false. Every read that starts after a commit returns that commit's state (REQ-CAT-010).

### CON-CAT-008 — Read a Variant (قراءة متغيّر / Read a Variant)
Signature : getVariant(variantPk: BIGINT) → Variant {variantPk, itemFk, code, nameAr, nameEn (derived, D-15), isDefaultFl, isActiveFl, Item baseUomCode, Item taxClassCode, effective einvoiceCodeTypeCode and einvoiceCode (Variant override, else Item), einvoiceUnitCode of the base unit (empty when the unit has no active Unit e-invoice code)} · errors: not found
Entity    : ENT-CAT-002
Traces    : ENT-CAT-002, REQ-CAT-050, REQ-CAT-119, REQ-CAT-122, REQ-CAT-029

An inactive Variant is still returned, with `isActiveFl` false (REQ-CAT-050).

### CON-CAT-009 — Read an Item unit (قراءة وحدة صنف / Read an Item unit)
Signature : getItemUnit(itemUnitPk: BIGINT) → Item unit {itemUnitPk, itemFk, uomCode, conversionFactor, isPurchaseFl, isSalesFl, isActiveFl, einvoiceUnitCode (empty when none is active)} · errors: not found
Entity    : ENT-CAT-008
Traces    : ENT-CAT-008, REQ-CAT-079, REQ-CAT-122

### CON-CAT-010 — Look up a barcode or scale label (البحث بالباركود أو ملصق الميزان / Barcode and scale label lookup)
Signature : lookupBarcode(value: text) → {variantPk, itemPk, uomCode, embeddedValue (weight or price, with the layout's decimals; empty for a plain barcode), embeddedValueTypeCode (WEIGHT / PRICE; empty for a plain barcode)} · errors: not found — no active barcode or scale layout matches (RULE-CAT-047); scale label not readable — wrong check digit or unknown scale code (RULE-CAT-035)
Entity    : ENT-CAT-009
Traces    : ENT-CAT-009, REQ-CAT-086, REQ-CAT-090, REQ-CAT-097, REQ-CAT-100

Only active barcodes of active Variants of active Items, and active scale label layouts, match (REQ-CAT-085, REQ-CAT-094, REQ-CAT-086 — ADR-CAT-059).

### CON-CAT-011 — Read a Category (قراءة فئة / Read a Category)
Signature : getCategory(categoryPk: BIGINT) → Category {categoryPk, code, nameAr, nameEn, parentCategoryFk, sortOrder, isActiveFl} · errors: not found
Entity    : ENT-CAT-006
Traces    : ENT-CAT-006, REQ-CAT-066, REQ-CAT-067

### CON-CAT-012 — Category tree (شجرة الفئات / Category tree)
Signature : getCategoryTree(activeOnly: flag) → tree of Category, each node under its parent and ordered by sortOrder · errors: none
Entity    : ENT-CAT-006
Traces    : ENT-CAT-006, REQ-CAT-067

### CON-CAT-013 — Items of a Category (أصناف الفئة / Items of a Category)
Signature : listCategoryItems(categoryPk: BIGINT, page, size) → page of active Items of the Category and of its active sub-categories · errors: not found
Entity    : ENT-CAT-001
Traces    : ENT-CAT-001, ENT-CAT-006, REQ-CAT-068

### CON-CAT-014 — Storefront catalogue read (كتالوج المتجر الإلكتروني / Storefront catalogue)
Signature : listStorefrontItems(page, size) → page of Items with isActiveFl true and publishStateCode PUBLISHED · errors: none
Entity    : ENT-CAT-001
Traces    : ENT-CAT-001, REQ-CAT-115, REQ-CAT-113, REQ-CAT-114

### CON-CAT-015 — Images of a Variant (صور المتغيّر / Images of a Variant)
Signature : getVariantImages(variantPk: BIGINT) → list of image {fileDocumentRef, nameAr, nameEn, isPrimaryFl, sortOrder} — the active images bound to the Variant, or else the Item's active images bound to no Variant, primary first · errors: not found
Entity    : ENT-CAT-002
Traces    : ENT-CAT-002, REQ-CAT-109

`fileDocumentRef` points to the given `file` public image storage (`erp-core:modules.file`).

### CON-CAT-016 — Catalogue search for the global search (بحث الكتالوج / Catalogue search)
Signature : searchCatalogue(term: text) → at most 20 active Items {itemPk, code, nameAr, nameEn} whose nameAr, nameEn, code or active barcode contains the term, exact code or barcode matches first · errors: term too short — fewer than 2 characters (RULE-CAT-046); forbidden — the caller lacks VIEW on CAT_ITEMS, answered as an empty result
Entity    : ENT-CAT-001
Traces    : ENT-CAT-001, REQ-CAT-125, REQ-CAT-126, REQ-CAT-127

The global search box sits outside CAT (ADR-CAT-043).

### CON-CAT-017 — Capability turn-off check (فحص إيقاف القدرة / Capability turn-off check)
Signature : checkCapabilityTurnOff(flag: `variants` | `bundles`) → {allowed: flag, dependentCount: number, dependentItems: at most 20 {itemPk, code, nameAr}, messageAr and messageEn (the RULE-CAT-010 or RULE-CAT-011 message with {count} filled when not allowed; empty when allowed)} · errors: invalid input — flag other than `variants` or `bundles`
Entity    : ENT-CAT-001
Traces    : ENT-CAT-001, REQ-CAT-021, REQ-CAT-022, REQ-CAT-023

This check is offered to the capability-flag owner (owner OPEN, P-02 — ADR-CAT-041). CAT does not own or change the flags.

## 3 — Event item

### CON-CAT-018 — Catalogue-change event (إشعار تغيير الكتالوج / Catalogue-change event)
Signature : catalogueChanged(entity: ENT id of the changed record — ENT-CAT-001, 002, 005, 007, 008, 009 or 010; recordPk: BIGINT; itemPk: BIGINT; changeKind: CAT_CHANGE_KIND — CREATED / UPDATED / DEACTIVATED / REACTIVATED) → one event per committed change, delivered after commit · errors: none — a rolled-back change publishes no event (RULE-CAT-049)
Entity    : ENT-CAT-001
Traces    : ENT-CAT-001, ENT-CAT-002, REQ-CAT-008, REQ-CAT-009

The event is recorded in the same transaction as the change through the given `events` outbox, and it is delivered only after commit. Consumers read the current state through CON-CAT-007 … CON-CAT-015; the event carries no field values.

## 4 — Given usage (repeated verbatim from SRS A9)

```yaml name=given-usage
rows:
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.mdl, via: com.erp.mdl.crossmodule.MdlLookupApi, purpose: "load the values of the CAT_* lookup keys (brand, unit of measure, tax class, e-invoice codes, barcode type, scale value type, item kind, publish state) at runtime"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.mdl, via: com.erp.mdl.crossmodule.MdlLookupApi, purpose: "serve CAT's own lookup keys to the screens (API-CAT-052) through the common owned-lookups capability, com.erp.common.lookup.OwnedLookups.read(key, the 10 CAT keys, CAT-404-LOOKUP-KEY-UNKNOWN, MdlLookupApi::readActiveValuesByKey) — never a pass-through for other keys (ADR-CAT-065); erp-core's manifest lists owned-lookups under common but publishes no interface for it, so the row names the mdl interface the call goes through"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.cu, via: com.erp.cu.crossmodule.SettingsApi, purpose: "read the `variants` and `bundles` capability flags behind the FeatureFlags API (ADR-CAT-041)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.sequence, via: com.erp.sequence.crossmodule.NumberSeriesApi, purpose: "issue Item codes (CAT_ITEM), Variant codes (CAT_VARIANT) and internal barcode digits (CAT_INTERNAL_BARCODE)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.file, via: docs/api-docs/file/index.md, purpose: "the client uploads Item images to the FILE category CAT_ITEM_IMAGE (allowPublic = true, PNG / JPEG / WEBP, at most 5 MB — the FILE endpoint refuses any other file, ADR-CAT-076) and import files to the private storage through the given FILE upload endpoints, and passes the returned FILE_DOCUMENT.ID to CAT; CAT has no multipart endpoint (ADR-CAT-056)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.file, via: com.erp.file.crossmodule.FileDocumentLookupApi, purpose: "the published methods only: isAvailable (a referenced file exists and is available in the caller's tenant — API-CAT-018, API-CAT-049), publicUrl and publicUrls (an image has a public URL, and image URLs for reads); the type, size and bytes of an import file are not published and wait on CORE-GAP-file-document-metadata-read (ADR-CAT-076)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.file, via: com.erp.file.crossmodule.FilePrivateStoreApi, purpose: "the private store that holds the uploaded xlsx import file (SCR-REQ-CAT-004, ADR-CAT-056), named in CORE-GAP-file-document-metadata-read as the candidate in-process read of that file's type, size and bytes for the import (RULE-CAT-044, API-CAT-049); CAT stores no file through it (the client uploads through the FILE endpoints) and wires the read when the core publishes it (ADR-CAT-076)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.events, via: com.erp.events.OutboxPublisher, purpose: "record catalogue-change events in the change transaction and deliver them after commit (RULE-CAT-049)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.report, via: com.erp.report.crossmodule.PrintApi, purpose: "produce the printable barcode label document (REQ-CAT-102) and the xlsx item import sheet (REQ-CAT-036)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.report, via: com.erp.report.ReportProvider, purpose: "register the catalogue reports CAT_BARCODE_LABEL and CAT_ITEM_IMPORT_SHEET (ADR-CAT-057)"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.sec, via: com.erp.sec.permission.PermissionContributor, purpose: "register the CAT page codes so the security module derives their VIEW/CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE permissions"}
  - {given: erp-core, module: modules.tenant, via: com.erp.tenant.TenantProvisioningContributor, purpose: "copy the 8 seeded Unit e-invoice codes into each newly provisioned tenant and register the FILE category CAT_ITEM_IMAGE there (ADR-CAT-076); the given copies the CAT lookup values and number series itself (ADR-CAT-058, REQ-CAT-134)"}
```

The contract does not promise any entity that a given provides. Tenant, User, Role, LookupType/LookupValue, FileDocument and NumberSeries stay with `erp-core` [C:C-GIVEN-1]. A new tenant receives the CAT seeds through the given provisioning (REQ-CAT-134, ADR-CAT-058), so every operation item works in every tenant from its first request.

## 5 — Stability

- The items above are ADDITIVE in CS-CAT-001. Later versions may add items freely.
- Changing or removing any CON-CAT item, a key column, or the BIGINT identifier type is legal only in a BREAKING change set with an ADR. `gov.py graph` then raises a resolution event on every consumer edge that cites the item.

Examples: `itemPk` → `ITEM_PK`, `isActiveFl` → `IS_ACTIVE_FL`, `einvoiceCodeTypeCode` → `EINVOICE_CODE_TYPE_CODE`. PostgreSQL folds unquoted names to lower case, which gives the same physical name as the given's UPPER_SNAKE convention and the default JPA physical naming. Table name = `CAT_` + entity abbreviation. Every identifier is at most 63 characters, and none is a reserved word (`KEY` and `VERSION` are non-reserved in PostgreSQL 16) |

Origin of the standard columns. Each table carries the SRS fields of its kind (A3). It also carries the given's entity column set: `tenantId`, `version`, `createdBy`, `createdAt`, `updatedBy`, `updatedAt` (erp-core `AuditableEntity` and the tenancy convention; D-P2-02). Each such column traces to its ENT and to a REQ that reads it. Examples: AC-CAT-004 reads `updatedBy`, and AC-CAT-018 and AC-CAT-021 read `updatedAt`.

RULE data sources. Every `ENT.field` named in a RULE `Data source` line of SRS A5 is bound to a DBF above (C6.9). The two exceptions are `ENT-CAT-002.nameAr` and `ENT-CAT-002.nameEn`. No RULE names them, and they are derived at read (D-P2-08).

## 3 — XM register

```yaml name=xm-register
records: []
```

CAT consumes no entity of another business module (SRS A8 `module-dependencies`: `consumes: []`). It is first in the fixed module order [KB:raw-idea.md §5]. So the module has no HARD-FK and no SOFT-READ edge, and the script creates no cross-module column.

Given references create no XM:
- `CAT_ITEM_MEDIA.FILE_DOCUMENT_REF` (DBF-CAT-122) holds the given `FILE_DOCUMENT` identifier. It is a given soft read with no constraint (SRS A3 "GIVEN, no XM edge").
- Every `TENANT_ID` column holds the given tenant identifier, with `FK_<TABLE>_TENANT → CORE_TENANT(ID)` (erp-core checklist C1). `CORE_TENANT` is a given table, so the FK is a permitted given reference and not an XM (ADR-CAT-055).
- Lookup codes are given lookup values read through `MdlLookupApi`.

## 4 — FULL_DATABASE_SCRIPT

```sql
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- CAT v2 — P2 — FULL_DATABASE_SCRIPT — PostgreSQL 16
-- Migration for CS-CAT-001 (ADDITIVE): the current state holds no earlier CAT script,
-- so this migration creates every CAT object. No schema prefix. Identifiers are UPPER_SNAKE_CASE, unquoted.
-- PK generation: GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY on every PK column (profile stack.db.pk_generation).
-- File: V1000__cat_catalog.sql (erp-core conventions § Migrations; the given core chain runs first).
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- BLOCK 1 — SEQUENCES, EXTENSION AND FUNCTION used by later blocks
-- Sequences: none. Every PK uses the identity clause. Item / Variant codes and internal
-- barcode digits come from the core number series (BLOCK 8c), never from a CAT sequence.
-- Extension pg_trgm: trigram indexes of BLOCK 7 (ADR-CAT-062). DEPLOYMENT PRECONDITION: the role that runs
-- Flyway holds the CREATE privilege on the database (pg_trgm is a trusted extension from PostgreSQL 13, so
-- CREATE is enough and no superuser is needed); where that grant is withheld, a DBA runs
-- `CREATE EXTENSION pg_trgm;` once before the first deployment and the statement below is a no-op.
-- Function CAT_NORMALIZE_AR: Arabic normalisation of RULE-CAT-003 and of search (ADR-CAT-062);
-- created here because UQ_CAT_ITEM_NAME_AR (BLOCK 5b) and the trigram indexes (BLOCK 7) use it.
-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION CAT_NORMALIZE_AR(P_TEXT TEXT) RETURNS TEXT
    LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE STRICT PARALLEL SAFE AS
$$ SELECT btrim(regexp_replace(lower(translate(regexp_replace(P_TEXT, '[ً-ٰٟـ]', '', 'g'),
                                                  'أإآٱةى', 'ااااهي')), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) $$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION CAT_NORMALIZE_AR(TEXT) IS 'RULE-CAT-003 / search: drops tashkeel and tatweel, folds أ إ آ ٱ to ا, ة to ه, ى to ي, lower-cases Latin, trims and collapses spaces (ADR-CAT-062)';

-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- BLOCK 2 — PARENT TABLES (no FK dependency on another CAT table)
-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE CAT_CATEGORY (
    CATEGORY_PK                 BIGINT        GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY,
    CODE                        VARCHAR(30)   NOT NULL,
    NAME_AR                     VARCHAR(200)  NOT NULL,
    NAME_EN                     VARCHAR(200),
    SORT_ORDER                  INTEGER       NOT NULL,
    IS_ACTIVE_FL                BOOLEAN       NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    PARENT_CATEGORY_FK          BIGINT,
    TENANT_ID                   BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    VERSION                     BIGINT        NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CREATED_BY                  VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    CREATED_AT                  TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL,
    UPDATED_BY                  VARCHAR(100),
    UPDATED_AT                  TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE TABLE CAT_VAR_ATTR (
    VARIANT_ATTRIBUTE_PK        BIGINT        GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY,
    CODE                        VARCHAR(30)   NOT NULL,
    NAME_AR                     VARCHAR(200)  NOT NULL,
    NAME_EN                     VARCHAR(200),
    SORT_ORDER                  INTEGER       NOT NULL,
    IS_ACTIVE_FL                BOOLEAN       NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    TENANT_ID                   BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    VERSION                     BIGINT        NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CREATED_BY                  VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    CREATED_AT                  TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL,
    UPDATED_BY                  VARCHAR(100),
    UPDATED_AT                  TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE TABLE CAT_SCALE_LABEL_LAYOUT (
    SCALE_LABEL_LAYOUT_PK       BIGINT        GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY,
    KEY                         VARCHAR(2)    NOT NULL,
    VALUE_AR                    VARCHAR(200),
    VALUE_EN                    VARCHAR(200),
    SCALE_CODE_LENGTH           INTEGER       NOT NULL DEFAULT 5,
    EMBEDDED_VALUE_TYPE_CODE    VARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    VALUE_DECIMALS              INTEGER       NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,
    IS_ACTIVE_FL                BOOLEAN       NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    TENANT_ID                   BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    VERSION                     BIGINT        NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CREATED_BY                  VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    CREATED_AT                  TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE CAT_UNIT_EINVOICE_CODE (
    UNIT_EINVOICE_CODE_PK       BIGINT        GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY,

    IS_ACTIVE_FL                BOOLEAN       NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    BUNDLE_ITEM_FK              BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    COMPONENT_VARIANT_FK        BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    TENANT_ID                   BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    VERSION                     BIGINT        NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CREATED_BY                  VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    CREATED_AT                  TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL,
    UPDATED_BY                  VARCHAR(100),
    UPDATED_AT                  TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE TABLE CAT_ITEM_UNIT (
    ITEM_UNIT_PK                BIGINT        GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY,
    UOM_CODE                    VARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    CONVERSION_FACTOR           NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL,
    IS_PURCHASE_FL              BOOLEAN       NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    IS_SALES_FL                 BOOLEAN       NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    IS_ACTIVE_FL                BOOLEAN       NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    ITEM_FK                     BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    TENANT_ID                   BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    VERSION                     BIGINT        NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CREATED_BY                  VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    CREATED_AT                  TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL,
    UPDATED_BY                  VARCHAR(100),
    UPDATED_AT                  TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE TABLE CAT_BARCODE (
    BARCODE_PK                  BIGINT        GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY,
    BARCODE_VALUE               VARCHAR(48)   NOT NULL,
    BARCODE_TYPE_CODE           VARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    UOM_CODE                    VARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    IS_ACTIVE_FL                BOOLEAN       NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    VARIANT_FK                  BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    TENANT_ID                   BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    VERSION                     BIGINT        NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CREATED_BY                  VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    CREATED_AT                  TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL,
    UPDATED_BY                  VARCHAR(100),
    UPDATED_AT                  TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE TABLE CAT_ITEM_MEDIA (
    ITEM_MEDIA_PK               BIGINT        GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY,
    FILE_DOCUMENT_REF           BIGINT        NOT NULL,   -- given erp-core FILE_DOCUMENT.ID: soft read, no constraint, no XM
    NAME_AR                     VARCHAR(200)  NOT NULL,
    NAME_EN                     VARCHAR(200),
    SORT_ORDER                  INTEGER       NOT NULL,
    IS_PRIMARY_FL               BOOLEAN       NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    IS_ACTIVE_FL                BOOLEAN       NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    ITEM_FK                     BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    VARIANT_FK                  BIGINT,
    TENANT_ID                   BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    VERSION                     BIGINT        NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CREATED_BY                  VARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    CREATED_AT                  TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL,
    UPDATED_BY                  VARCHAR(100),
    UPDATED_AT                  TIMESTAMPTZ
);

ALTER TABLE CAT_CATEGORY       ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_CAT_CATEGORY_CODE       UNIQUE (TENANT_ID, CODE);                          -- RULE-CAT-024
ALTER TABLE CAT_VAR_ATTR       ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_CAT_VAR_ATTR_CODE       UNIQUE (TENANT_ID, CODE);                          -- RULE-CAT-016

ALTER TABLE CAT_VAR_ATTR_VALUE ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_CAT_VAR_ATTR_VALUE_CODE UNIQUE (TENANT_ID, VARIANT_ATTRIBUTE_FK, CODE);    -- RULE-CAT-016
ALTER TABLE CAT_VARIANT        ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_CAT_VARIANT_CODE        UNIQUE (TENANT_ID, CODE);                          -- RULE-CAT-004

ALTER TABLE CAT_VARIANT        ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_CAT_VARIANT_PK             UNIQUE (TENANT_ID, VARIANT_PK);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UQ_CAT_VAR_ATTR_VALUE_NAME_AR ON CAT_VAR_ATTR_VALUE (TENANT_ID, VARIANT_ATTRIBUTE_FK, NAME_AR) WHERE IS_ACTIVE_FL;          -- RULE-CAT-016

ALTER TABLE CAT_ITEM ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_CAT_ITEM_EINVOICE_CODE CHECK ((EINVOICE_CODE_TYPE_CODE IS NULL) = (EINVOICE_CODE IS NULL));       -- RULE-CAT-042

ALTER TABLE CAT_VAR_ATTR_VALUE ADD CONSTRAINT CHK_CAT_VAR_ATTR_VALUE_NAME_AR CHECK (NAME_AR ~ '[\u0621-\u064A]');                         -- RULE-CAT-001

-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- BLOCK 8 — LOOKUP AND REFERENCE SEED DATA (PLATFORM tenant, TENANT_ID = 1).
-- New tenants (ADR-CAT-058, REQ-CAT-134): the given copies 8a/8b (erp-core mdl) and 8c (sequence,
-- counter at 1) from PLATFORM at provisioning; CatTenantProvisioningContributor (given TenantProvisioningContributor)
-- copies 8d with an explicit TENANT_ID.
-- Column names verified against erp-core 1.6.0 (V3__mdl_schema.sql + V10__tenant_schema.sql for MDL_*,
-- V14__sequence_and_settings.sql for CORE_NUMBER_SERIES, V10 for CORE_TENANT ID 1 = 'PLATFORM') and written
-- the way the core's own seed V8__mdl_seed.sql writes them (D-P2-13). VERSION defaults to 0 in each table.
-- No COMMIT: Flyway runs a PostgreSQL migration in its own transaction and commits it.
-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- 8a — lookup types. Table owned by erp-core modules.mdl (MDL_LOOKUP_TYPE); the keys are owned by CAT (SRS A6).
-- OWNER_MODULE_CODE 'CAT' is the permission module CatPermissions declares (RULE-MDL-001 is checked
-- application-side against SEC_MODULE_REG, which the given fills from the contributor at startup).
INSERT INTO MDL_LOOKUP_TYPE (LOOKUP_TYPE_PK, TENANT_ID, KEY, OWNER_MODULE_CODE, NAME_AR, NAME_EN, IS_ACTIVE_FL, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT)
SELECT nextval('SEQ_MDL_LOOKUP_TYPE'), 1, v.TYPE_KEY, 'CAT', v.NAME_AR, v.NAME_EN, TRUE, 'SYSTEM', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM (VALUES
    (1, 'CAT_ITEM_KIND', 'نوع الصنف', 'Item kind'),
    (2, 'CAT_PUBLISH_STATE', 'حالة النشر', 'Publish state'),
    (3, 'CAT_BRAND', 'العلامة التجارية', 'Brand'),
    (4, 'CAT_UOM', 'وحدة القياس', 'Unit of measure'),
    (5, 'CAT_TAX_CLASS', 'التصنيف الضريبي', 'Tax class'),
    (6, 'CAT_EINVOICE_ITEM_CODE_TYPE', 'نوع رمز الفاتورة الإلكترونية', 'E-invoice code type'),
    (7, 'CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT', 'وحدة الفاتورة الإلكترونية', 'E-invoice unit'),
    (8, 'CAT_BARCODE_TYPE', 'نوع الباركود', 'Barcode type'),
    (9, 'CAT_SCALE_VALUE_TYPE', 'نوع القيمة المضمّنة', 'Embedded value type'),
    (10, 'CAT_CHANGE_KIND', 'نوع تغيير الكتالوج', 'Catalogue change kind')
) AS v (ORD, TYPE_KEY, NAME_AR, NAME_EN)
ORDER BY v.ORD;

-- 8b — lookup values. Table owned by erp-core modules.mdl (MDL_LOOKUP_VALUE); the values are owned by CAT (SRS A6).
-- CAT_BRAND has no seeded value (the tenant builds its own list). LOOKUP_TYPE_ID is resolved by KEY.
INSERT INTO MDL_LOOKUP_VALUE (LOOKUP_VALUE_PK, TENANT_ID, LOOKUP_TYPE_ID, CODE, NAME_AR, NAME_EN, SORT_ORDER, IS_ACTIVE_FL, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT)
SELECT nextval('SEQ_MDL_LOOKUP_VALUE'), 1, t.LOOKUP_TYPE_PK, v.CODE, v.NAME_AR, v.NAME_EN, v.SORT_ORDER, TRUE, 'SYSTEM', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM (VALUES
    ('CAT_ITEM_KIND', 'STANDARD', 'صنف عادي', 'Standard item', 1),
    ('CAT_ITEM_KIND', 'BUNDLE', 'حزمة', 'Bundle', 2),
    ('CAT_PUBLISH_STATE', 'UNPUBLISHED', 'غير منشور', 'Not published', 1),
    ('CAT_PUBLISH_STATE', 'PUBLISHED', 'منشور', 'Published', 2),
    ('CAT_UOM', 'PIECE', 'قطعة', 'Piece', 1),
    ('CAT_UOM', 'CARTON', 'كرتونة', 'Carton', 2),
    ('CAT_UOM', 'BOX', 'علبة', 'Box', 3),
    ('CAT_UOM', 'DOZEN', 'دستة', 'Dozen', 4),
    ('CAT_UOM', 'KILOGRAM', 'كيلوجرام', 'Kilogram', 5),
    ('CAT_UOM', 'GRAM', 'جرام', 'Gram', 6),
    ('CAT_UOM', 'METRE', 'متر', 'Metre', 7),
    ('CAT_UOM', 'LITRE', 'لتر', 'Litre', 8),
    ('CAT_TAX_CLASS', 'STANDARD', 'خاضع للنسبة العامة', 'Standard rate', 1),
    ('CAT_TAX_CLASS', 'ZERO_RATED', 'خاضع لنسبة صفر', 'Zero-rated', 2),
    ('CAT_TAX_CLASS', 'EXEMPT', 'معفى', 'Exempt', 3),
    ('CAT_EINVOICE_ITEM_CODE_TYPE', 'GS1', 'GS1', 'GS1', 1),
    ('CAT_EINVOICE_ITEM_CODE_TYPE', 'EGS', 'EGS', 'EGS', 2),
    ('CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT', 'EA', 'وحدة', 'Each', 1),
    ('CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT', 'KGM', 'كيلوجرام', 'Kilogram', 2),
    ('CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT', 'GRM', 'جرام', 'Gram', 3),
    ('CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT', 'MTR', 'متر', 'Metre', 4),
    ('CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT', 'LTR', 'لتر', 'Litre', 5),
    ('CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT', 'CT', 'كرتونة', 'Carton', 6),
    ('CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT', 'BX', 'علبة', 'Box', 7),
    ('CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT', 'DZN', 'دستة', 'Dozen', 8),
    ('CAT_BARCODE_TYPE', 'GTIN', 'GTIN', 'GTIN', 1),

### Self-verification (§7.2)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| SYNTAX S-1 … S-8 | Every statement ends with `;`. No trailing comma. Every CAT object referenced is created above. The given tables of BLOCK 8 (MDL_LOOKUP_TYPE, MDL_LOOKUP_VALUE, CORE_NUMBER_SERIES) and the FK target CORE_TENANT of BLOCK 5e are created by the given's own migration chain, which runs before application scripts. Types come only from §4.1, plus INTEGER declared in the header. All constraints are in ALTER TABLE form. No PK trigger, no PK sequence default. INSERTs carry column lists, named as erp-core 1.6.0 names them (D-P2-13). No transaction statement: Flyway owns the migration's transaction. No schema prefix. No placeholders |
| PK strategy | 12 of 12 PK columns use `GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY`. No PK sequence |
| Order | Parent tables come before child tables. Every PK is added before any UNIQUE or FK, and the UNIQUE targets of the tenant-composite FKs are added before those FKs. The lookup types are inserted before the lookup values |
| Deployment preconditions | The given core migration chain (V1 … V34 of erp-core 1.6.0) has run. The Flyway role holds CREATE on the database for `pg_trgm`, or a DBA has installed `pg_trgm` beforehand (BLOCK 1) |
| Completeness | 12 of 12 ENT have a table, and every stored SRS field has a DBF. The two derived Variant names are not stored (D-P2-08). All 10 lookup keys are seeded (34 values). The shared lookup tables are not re-created |
| Cross-module | No XM, so no cross-module column. No constraint references another business module's table. The only constraint to a given table is `FK_<TABLE>_TENANT → CORE_TENANT(ID)` on the 12 tables (checklist C1, ADR-CAT-055); FILE_DOCUMENT_REF and the lookup and series codes are soft reads with no constraint. Every intra-module FK is composite with TENANT_ID (D-P2-12, ADR-CAT-067) |
| Trace | Every DBF traces to its ENT.field and to at least 1 REQ. No XM exists, so no orphan XM and no dangling id |

## 5 — Decisions applied

| DEFAULT | What | Source | Override |
|---|---|---|---|
| D-P2-01 | Identifier transformation: camelCase → UPPER_SNAKE_CASE, unquoted. PostgreSQL stores the name in lower case, which matches the given's physical naming. Tables are named `CAT_` + entity abbreviation (VAR_ATTR = Variant attribute, COMP = component) | brief §3; given migrations convention | Rename in a later delta (breaking for consumers of physical names) |
| D-P2-02 | Every table carries the given entity column set: TENANT_ID, VERSION, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT. This includes the lookup tables (ENT-CAT-003, 004) and config tables (ENT-CAT-011, 012), whose SRS kind lists no audit fields. The source is the given's tenancy rule (every table has `TENANT_ID BIGINT NOT NULL`; every entity extends `AuditableEntity`). SRS A2 says "Tenancy is handled by the given core", and SRS A3 says audit fields are filled by the system. Without these columns the given's base entity cannot map the table | SRS A2, A3; given erp-core 1.6.0 conventions (tenancy, migrations) | Drop the columns from the lookup and config tables only if the given allows an entity that does not extend `AuditableEntity` |
| D-P2-03 | Every table has a `TENANT_ID` NOT NULL column, an index led by `TENANT_ID` (a non-partial UNIQUE of 5b or an `IDX_<TABLE>_TENANT_ID` of BLOCK 7), and every UNIQUE composite with `TENANT_ID`. Every table also carries `FK_<TABLE>_TENANT FOREIGN KEY (TENANT_ID) REFERENCES CORE_TENANT (ID)` (BLOCK 5e). The tenant table is the given erp-core `CORE_TENANT`, so the FK is a permitted given reference and not an XM. This supersedes ADR-CAT-054. The factory's explicit exemption of this FK from C6.15 is OPEN platform finding 1 in business-policies-cat.md | brief §5.1; erp-core checklist C1; conventions § Migrations rule 5; ADR-CAT-055 | — |
| D-P2-04 | The PK is `{entity}Pk` with the identity clause. This replaces the given's `ID` + `SEQ_<TABLE>` default, because the profile decision governs and one database carries one PK strategy | profile `stack.db.pk_generation`, `naming.pk_pattern`; brief §4 | Profile change only |
| D-P2-05 | Lookup-backed columns are `VARCHAR(50)` and hold the code. They carry no CHECK of allowed codes and no DB default. The service applies the SRS defaults (STANDARD, PIECE, STANDARD, UNPUBLISHED — D-09) and validates against the active values in `mdl` (RULE-CAT-006) | profile lookups rule; given lookups convention | — |
| D-P2-06 | Logical `number` → `INTEGER`, declared once in the header. Decimal precision: `quantity` NUMERIC(18,3) and `conversionFactor` NUMERIC(18,6). The SRS fixes the scale only; 15 and 12 integer digits are enough for any retail quantity | SRS A3 (3 and 6 decimals) | Widen the precision in a later delta (non-breaking) |
| D-P2-07 | `createdBy` and `updatedBy` are `VARCHAR(100)` principal strings. The created pair is NOT NULL and the updated pair is NULL until the first update | brief §3 audit rule; given migrations convention | — |
| D-P2-08 | Variant `nameAr` and `nameEn` are derived at read (SRS D-15) and are not stored. A stored copy would go stale when a value is renamed (AC-CAT-048) | SRS ENT-CAT-002, D-15 | Store an owner override name if D-15 changes |
| D-P2-09 | Unit e-invoice code `valueAr` and `valueEn` are stored (config-kind defaults) and nullable. The service copies them from the CAT_UOM labels at save; they are never entered | SRS ENT-CAT-012; profile entity_defaults.config | Derive at read and drop the columns in a later delta |
| D-P2-10 | Rules that apply among active records are partial unique indexes named `UQ_…`. The Item Arabic name is compared after `CAT_NORMALIZE_AR` (tashkeel and tatweel dropped, alef / taa marbuta / alef maqsura folded, Latin lower-cased, spaces trimmed and collapsed — RULE-CAT-003, ADR-CAT-062). Rows from the same import file are checked by the service | SRS RULE-CAT-003, 016, 019, 024, 027, 029, 034, 039, 043 | — |
| D-P2-11 | Barcode uniqueness is one partial unique index on the value among active barcodes. A SCALE code has 4–6 digits (RULE-CAT-033, RULE-CAT-034); a GTIN has 8–14 and an INTERNAL code has 13. So a SCALE code can never equal a GTIN or INTERNAL value, and RULE-CAT-029's per-type comparison holds without naming a lookup code in DDL | SRS RULE-CAT-029, 030, 033 | — |
| D-P2-12 | Same-tenant and same-parent integrity are structural. Every intra-module FK of 5d is composite with `TENANT_ID` and targets a `(TENANT_ID, <PK>)` UNIQUE of its parent (UQ_CAT_CATEGORY_PK, UQ_CAT_VAR_ATTR_PK, UQ_CAT_ITEM_PK, UQ_CAT_VARIANT_PK), so a row can never point to a parent of another tenant, even through a native query or a script that bypasses the given tenant filter (ADR-CAT-067). Two FKs also hold a same-parent rule: an assignment's value belongs to its attribute (RULE-CAT-013), and a media record's Variant belongs to its Item (RULE-CAT-040; no check when the Variant is empty — MATCH SIMPLE) | SRS RULE-CAT-013, RULE-CAT-040; erp-core conventions § Tenancy; ADR-CAT-067 | — |
| D-P2-13 | Seeds go into the given's tables by the columns of erp-core 1.6.0, checked against its migrations (gate-analysis round 2, G14): `MDL_LOOKUP_TYPE (LOOKUP_TYPE_PK from SEQ_MDL_LOOKUP_TYPE, TENANT_ID, KEY, OWNER_MODULE_CODE VARCHAR(10), NAME_AR, NAME_EN — both NOT NULL —, IS_ACTIVE_FL, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, VERSION default 0)` (V3 + V10); `MDL_LOOKUP_VALUE (LOOKUP_VALUE_PK from SEQ_MDL_LOOKUP_VALUE, TENANT_ID, LOOKUP_TYPE_ID → LOOKUP_TYPE_PK, CODE, NAME_AR, NAME_EN, SORT_ORDER, IS_ACTIVE_FL, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT)` (V3 + V10); `CORE_NUMBER_SERIES (ID from SEQ_CORE_NUMBER_SERIES, TENANT_ID, CODE, PREFIX, PATTERN, RESET_POLICY; PERIOD_KEY, NEXT_VALUE, IS_ACTIVE, CREATED_AT, VERSION by default)` (V14); `CORE_TENANT` row ID 1 = `PLATFORM` (V10). Result: the earlier names `ID`, `LABEL_AR`, `LABEL_EN` of the mdl tables were wrong and are replaced, `NAME_AR` / `NAME_EN` are added to the type rows, and the series columns and the PLATFORM id were right. The rows follow the core's own seed `V8__mdl_seed.sql` (types by KEY, values joined by KEY) | brief §4.2 (the key owner owns the seed); given lookups convention; erp-core 1.6.0 V3, V8, V10, V14 | Adjust the column names only if a later erp-core release renames them; keys and values are fixed by SRS A6 |
| D-P2-14 | The number series CAT_ITEM (ITM-000001), CAT_VARIANT (VAR-000001) and CAT_INTERNAL_BARCODE (10 digits) are seeded in `CORE_NUMBER_SERIES` with RESET_POLICY NEVER, so the first save does not fail with `SEQUENCE_NOT_CONFIGURED`. The given copies the series to every new tenant with the counter at 1, and the Unit e-invoice codes are copied by `CatTenantProvisioningContributor` (REQ-CAT-134, ADR-CAT-058) | SRS D-11; given numbering convention; ADR-CAT-058 | Patterns are configurable per tenant in the core sequence module |
| D-P2-15 | The 8 Unit e-invoice codes of D-12 are seeded for the PLATFORM tenant (AC-CAT-097 lists 8 active ones) | SRS D-12, ENT-CAT-012 | Re-map against the authority's code table |
| D-P2-16 | These rules stay with the service and are not DDL, because they need other rows, flags, files or sequences: RULE-CAT-004, 005, 006, 007, 008, 009, 010, 011, 012, 013 (unique combination), 014, 015, 017, 018 (at least one line), 019 (active, STANDARD), 020, 021, 022, 023 (active parent, no cycle, depth ≤ 5), 025, 026, 027 (differs from base unit), 028, 030 (check digit), 031, 032, 033 (length), 035, 036, 037, 038, 039 (exactly one), 040 (when the Variant is empty), 041, 042 (GS1 / EGS format), 044, 045, 046, 047, 048, 049 | SRS A5 | — |
| D-P2-17 | Profile check CM-8: CAT holds no stock quantity, no monetary amount and no price (SRS A2 out of scope: PRC, INV). No warehouse, currency or price-list dimension applies to a CAT row | SRS A2; profile CM-8 | — |
| D-P2-18 | Delta: the current state holds no earlier CAT db-script, so this v2 migration creates every object. The DBF sequence starts at 001 (next free 162). No XM exists (next free XM sequence 001) | brief delta rule; change-manifest CS-CAT-001 | — |

No question was asked. ADR-CAT-054 (repair round 1) is superseded by ADR-CAT-055 (gate-analysis revise); ADR-CAT-058 (tenant provisioning), ADR-CAT-062 (Arabic normalisation, trigram indexes) and ADR-CAT-067 (tenant-composite intra-module FKs) also shape this script. ADR-CAT-072 (the default Variant moves) changes only the comments of `IS_DEFAULT_FL` and `UQ_CAT_VARIANT_DEFAULT`: the index stays non-partial, because the service clears the former default before it sets the new one. The next free ADR sequence for CAT, per the current registries, is 077. Profile check CM-3 holds: every flag column (`IS_ACTIVE_FL`, `IS_DEFAULT_FL`, `IS_PURCHASE_FL`, `IS_SALES_FL`, `IS_PRIMARY_FL`) ends with the flag suffix `Fl` under the transformation of D-P2-01.

# Flow diagram — Catalog / الكتالوج (CAT) — v2

Module : CAT · Version : v2 · Stage : P3.2 Part A · Profile : commerce
Inputs : srs (SCR-REQ-CAT-001 … 006, REQ/AC), prd (US-CAT-001 … 022, priorities)
Screens: SCR-CAT-001 Items · SCR-CAT-002 Categories · SCR-CAT-003 Variant attributes · SCR-CAT-004 Item import · SCR-CAT-005 Barcode labels · SCR-CAT-006 Catalogue settings

This is a delta run, but the current state holds no earlier flow diagram, so every flow below is ADDED. The flows carry no atom of their own. Each one is named by its starting screen and a short name, and each cites a story and a screen that the SRS declares. Menu entries follow two rules: a menu entry appears only with the VIEW permission of its page code, and an entry bound to a capability flag appears only while that flag is on (UXD-CAT-002).

```
Catalog / الكتالوج
├── Items / الأصناف                         SCR-CAT-001   PERM_CAT_ITEMS_VIEW
├── Categories / الفئات                      SCR-CAT-002   PERM_CAT_CATEGORIES_VIEW
├── Variant attributes / خصائص المتغيّرات    SCR-CAT-003   PERM_CAT_VARIANT_ATTRIBUTES_VIEW · only while `variants` is on
├── Item import / استيراد الأصناف            SCR-CAT-004   PERM_CAT_ITEM_IMPORT_VIEW  (also setup wizard step 5)
├── Barcode labels / ملصقات الباركود         SCR-CAT-005   PERM_CAT_BARCODE_LABELS_VIEW
└── Catalogue settings / إعدادات الكتالوج    SCR-CAT-006   PERM_CAT_SETTINGS_VIEW
```

Sequence  : Categories → Category entry drawer → "Items of this category" summary row → second-level drawer (active Items of the Category and its active sub-categories) → row → Items · Entry `/cat/items/:itemPk` · or "Items directly in this category / الأصناف المباشرة في هذه الفئة" → Items · Search `?categoryFk=<categoryPk>` (the Category itself, without its sub-categories)
Trigger   : the owner checks what a Category holds before moving or deactivating it
Priority  : — (US-CAT-013)
```

# Frontend execution plan — Catalog / الكتالوج (CAT) — v2

Module : CAT · Version : v2 · Stage : P3.2 Part B · Track : frontend · Plan : exec · Profile : commerce
Stack  : `react-ts-vite` · routing `react-router` · server state `tanstack-query` · forms `react-hook-form` · validation `zod` · state `zustand` · one lazy chunk per composite screen
Bound to: `api-spec-cat.yaml` (OpenAPI 3.1.0, 55 operations, base path `/api/v1/cat`, bearer JWT). The frontend executor's mock server serves the same document until the backend is delivered.
Design : `ui-ux-spec-cat.md` (SCR-CAT-001 … 006, UXD-CAT-001 … 003) · `flow-diagram-cat.md`
Decisions: ADR-CAT-049 (Items: one Save owning ordered calls) · ADR-CAT-050 (display data served by the given) · ADR-CAT-051 (API coverage and binding notes); earlier: ADR-CAT-043, ADR-CAT-044, ADR-CAT-048; gate-analysis revise: ADR-CAT-056 (files through the given FILE endpoints), ADR-CAT-059 (reactivation invariants), ADR-CAT-060 (unit used by barcodes); second gate-analysis revise: ADR-CAT-063 (inactive parent refuses child writes), ADR-CAT-064 (layout keeps its scale code length), ADR-CAT-065 (CAT lookup keys served through API-CAT-052); third gate-analysis revise: ADR-CAT-068 (three repairs stay allowed on an inactive Item), ADR-CAT-069 (reactivation of Categories, Variant attributes and values); eighth gate-analysis revise: ADR-CAT-076 (image type and size held by the FILE category CAT_ITEM_IMAGE)

This is a delta run, but the current state holds no earlier frontend plan, so every block below is ADDED. The plan says WHAT each screen reads, validates and renders. Method, path, request and response schema, paging and envelope are read in `api-spec-cat.yaml` by `x-api-id`, not copied here.

## 3.0 Binding to the API document

Reconciliation against the SRS (run once, before any phase):
- **REQ → operation**: 146 of 147 REQs bind to at least one operation that a CAT screen calls (block below). REQ-CAT-115 (storefront read) is served by `API-CAT-046`, which no CAT screen calls; SFR consumes it (ADR-CAT-051). No REQ needs an operation the document lacks. Lookup values (REQ-CAT-073, 074, 076) are served by CAT's own read `API-CAT-052` through `OwnedLookups` (UXD-CAT-001 — ADR-CAT-065), and capability flags (REQ-CAT-011 … 015) by the given (UXD-CAT-002 — ADR-CAT-050).
- **Operation → REQ**: every one of the 55 operations carries `x-traces` to at least one REQ, so no operation is unknown. Two operations (`API-CAT-011`, `API-CAT-046`) are not called by a CAT screen (ADR-CAT-051).
- **Envelope**: success bodies are `ApiResponse<T>` (`data`, `code`, `messageAr`, `messageEn`). Errors are `LocalizedError` (`code`, `messageAr`, `messageEn`). Paged reads (`x-paginated`) take `page` / `size`. Two binary bodies exist: the import sheet (xlsx, `API-CAT-048`) and the label document (PDF, `API-CAT-050`).
- **Platform-standard codes** (ADR-CAT-044) map to no RULE and are routed generically: `CAT-400-REQUEST-INVALID` → generic message · `CAT-401-UNAUTHENTICATED` → login · `CAT-403-FORBIDDEN` → unauthorized view (or a hidden affordance for an auxiliary read — ADR-CAT-051 §4) · `CAT-404-NOT-FOUND` → not-found state · `CAT-409-STALE-VERSION` → stale-version banner with Reload · a rejection of the given FILE upload (step 1 of an image or an import — ADR-CAT-056) → inline on the file input, showing the FILE envelope's messageAr / messageEn · `CAT-500-SERVER-ERROR` → generic message with Try again. In every case the text is the envelope's `messageAr` / `messageEn`.

## F1 — Models & Types

Field and DTO binding: the request and response schemas of this module's operations in `api-spec-cat.yaml` are the source. The blocks below name which schema each screen binds, by operation, and add only the UI-side types that exist in neither the document nor the SRS (form state, pending lines, URL filter objects). TypeScript types are generated from the document (one generator run, no hand-written DTO). Every UI type below is a projection of a generated type.

Shared across screens:
- `ApiResponse<T>` and `Page<T>` (`content`, `page`, `size`, `totalElements`, `totalPages`) wrap every read. `LocalizedError` is the error body.
- `LookupOption = { code, labelAr, labelEn, sortOrder }` is the UI shape of a given lookup value (UXD-CAT-001), as `API-CAT-052` returns it. It carries no activity flag: the operation returns active values only (ADR-CAT-073). `CapabilityFlags = { variants: boolean | unknown, bundles: boolean | unknown }` is the UI shape of the given flags (UXD-CAT-002). `unknown` means unreadable (REQ-CAT-013).
- `PendingState = 'new' | 'changed' | 'deactivate' | 'reactivate' | 'failed'` marks a child line not yet sent (ADR-CAT-049; `reactivate` for an inactive value line — ADR-CAT-069). It is UI-only and never sent.

### F1 · SCR-CAT-001 — Items

Bound schemas: search `ItemSummary` page (API-CAT-038) · read `ItemDetail` with `VariantSummary`, `AttributeValueView`, `BarcodeView`, `ItemUnitView`, `BundleComponentView`, `MediaView` (API-CAT-002) · `VariantDetail` (API-CAT-007) · create `ItemCreateRequest` (API-CAT-001) · update `ItemUpdateRequest` (API-CAT-003) · state `ItemStateRequest` (API-CAT-005) · deactivate response `ItemSummary` (API-CAT-004) · `VariantGenerationRequest` → `VariantGenerationResult` (API-CAT-006) · `VariantOverrideRequest` (API-CAT-008) · `ItemUnitCreateRequest` / `ItemUnitUpdateRequest` (API-CAT-010 / 012) · `BarcodeCreateRequest` / `InternalBarcodeRequest` (API-CAT-014 / 015) · `BundleComponentsRequest` (API-CAT-017) · `ItemMediaCreateRequest` (JSON carrying `fileDocumentRef`) / `ItemMediaUpdateRequest` (API-CAT-018 / 019) · Variant, unit, barcode and media deactivations (API-CAT-009, 013, 016, 020) · `CategoryNode` (API-CAT-039) · `VariantAttributeView` (API-CAT-041) · `BarcodeLookupResult` (API-CAT-043) · `MediaView` list (API-CAT-044) · `CatalogueSettings` (API-CAT-045) · `CatalogueSearchHit` (API-CAT-047).

UI types:
- `ItemSearchFilters = { text?, categoryFk?, brandCode?, itemKindCode?, publishStateCode?, isActiveFl?, page, size }`. It is the URL search params of `/cat/items`, parsed and defaulted (`isActiveFl: true`, `page: 0`, `size: 20`). `itemKindCode` is dropped while `bundles` is off.
- `ItemForm`. Header: the `ItemUpdateRequest` properties the user edits (`nameAr`, `nameEn`, `categoryFk`, `brandCode`, `taxClassCode`, `einvoiceCodeTypeCode`, `einvoiceCode`, `descriptionAr`, `descriptionEn`), plus `itemKindCode` and `baseUomCode` on create only, plus `version` on update. Collections: `bundleLines[]` (`bundleComponentPk?`, `componentVariantFk`, `quantity`, `sortOrder`); `units[]` (`ItemUnitView` + `pending`); `barcodes[]` (`BarcodeView` + `pending`, or a new `{ variantFk, barcodeTypeCode, barcodeValue?, uomCode, internal: boolean }`); `variantOverrides[]` (`variantPk`, `einvoiceCodeTypeCode`, `einvoiceCode`, `version`); `variantDeactivations[]` (`variantPk`); `generation?` (`selections[]` as in `VariantGenerationRequest`); `media[]` (`MediaView` + `pending`, or a new `{ file: File, fileDocumentRef?, nameAr, nameEn?, variantFk? }` — `fileDocumentRef` is filled by the given FILE upload during Save, ADR-CAT-056).
- Never sent (ADR-CAT-051 §6): `code` on any request; `itemKindCode` / `baseUomCode` on update; `conversionFactor` on Item unit update. `bundleComponents` is omitted on create of a STANDARD Item: it is optional with default `[]` (ADR-CAT-051 §6 as amended).
- `ItemRouteState = { itemPk | 'new', variant?, drawer?: '<line-kind>:<id|new>', picker?: 'variant-generation' | 'bundle-components' }`, parsed from the route and its search params.

## F2 — Data Hooks

These blocks declare what each screen reads and changes, not hook code. Rules shared by every screen:
- **Hook layering**: components use the screen facade only, and the facade uses only the queries declared here (server-state library `tanstack-query`).
- **Cache keys**: page and page size live inside the filter object that forms the cache key. Every filter that changes the response is in the key. The filter object is the route's search params, so back/forward restores a list.
- **Navigation state**: the router holds every open drawer and second level. No `zustand` store holds server data or open state; `zustand` is used by CAT only for the per-user list page size preference.
- **Cache policy**: defaults (staleTime 0, gcTime 5 min, refetch on focus), with three deviations recorded in ADR-CAT-050 / 051:
  - lookups (UXD-CAT-001): staleTime 30 min, gcTime 60 min;
  - the Category tree used as options: staleTime 5 min;
  - capability flags (UXD-CAT-002): staleTime 0, refetched on every screen entry and window focus (REQ-CAT-012).
- **Error routing**: every server code routed to a control names its text by reference: the RULE message (SRS) in ar and en, as the envelope carries it. Platform codes route as §3.0 states.
- **Loading**: LOCAL everywhere (skeleton or button progress). No call is declared slow by the SRS, so no GLOBAL loading.

Lookups shared by all screens (one hook per key, each bound to CAT's own read `API-CAT-052` `GET /api/v1/cat/lookups/{key}` — UXD-CAT-001, ADR-CAT-065; options are the active values with code and ar/en labels; a code on a record that is not among the active options — a value deactivated later (REQ-CAT-076) — is rendered as the raw code, in both languages, because no read of an inactive value exists until `CORE-GAP-lookup-inactive-value-label.md` is answered (ADR-CAT-073); when it is, `API-CAT-052` gains an optional `codes` parameter and `LookupOption.isActiveFl`, and the hooks label every rendered code):
`CAT_BRAND-LOOKUP` · `CAT_UOM-LOOKUP` · `CAT_TAX_CLASS-LOOKUP` · `CAT_ITEM_KIND-LOOKUP` · `CAT_PUBLISH_STATE-LOOKUP` · `CAT_EINVOICE_ITEM_CODE_TYPE-LOOKUP` · `CAT_BARCODE_TYPE-LOOKUP` · `CAT_SCALE_VALUE_TYPE-LOOKUP` · `CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT-LOOKUP`. Each has cache key `[cat, lookups, <KEY>]`. On error the field shows the raw code and the select is disabled, with the generic message; `CAT-404-LOOKUP-KEY-UNKNOWN` would mean the screen asked for a key that is not CAT's, which is a defect.

`CAPABILITY-FLAGS-INIT` (UXD-CAT-002): reads `variants` and `bundles` through the platform app configuration, with cache key `[platform, app-config]`. An unreadable value is `unknown` and is treated as off for display, with RULE-CAT-009's text shown where the function would be.

#### ITEM-SEARCH-QUERY — API-CAT-038            traces=API-CAT-038,REQ-CAT-003,REQ-CAT-014,REQ-CAT-015
Read query. The filter object is the URL search params. `itemKindCode` is never sent while `bundles` is off (REQ-CAT-015). Results are sorted by nameAr on the server. The Category column is labelled from the row's own `categoryNameAr` (in en `categoryNameEn`, else `categoryNameAr`) — derived by the server for the Category the Item points to, active or inactive (ADR-CAT-075); the brand, kind and publish columns are labelled from their lookups, a code not among the active options showing as the raw code (ADR-CAT-073).

#### ITEM-QUERY — API-CAT-002            traces=API-CAT-002,REQ-CAT-001,REQ-CAT-002,REQ-CAT-010,REQ-CAT-029,REQ-CAT-058,REQ-CAT-119
Read query, enabled when `itemPk` is a number. An itemPk of another tenant answers CAT-404-NOT-FOUND (REQ-CAT-132) and shows the not-found state. It feeds the header, every pane, the Barcode unit options (`baseUomCode` + active `itemUnits[].uomCode` — RULE-CAT-031), the image Variant options (`variants[]`), and the version tokens of the Item, Variants, units and media. It is re-read after every Save, so the committed state is what is shown (REQ-CAT-010).

#### CATEGORY-OPTIONS-QUERY — API-CAT-039            traces=API-CAT-039,REQ-CAT-072
Read query feeding the Category tree select and the Category filter with **active nodes only** (`isActiveFl: true`), so an inactive Category is never offered for selection (REQ-CAT-066).

#### Category labels — API-CAT-038, API-CAT-002            traces=API-CAT-038,API-CAT-002,REQ-CAT-066,REQ-CAT-072
A rendered `categoryFk` — the results column, the Entry header and the read-only Category field — is labelled from the Item read itself: `ItemSummary` / `ItemDetail` carry `categoryCode`, `categoryNameAr` and `categoryNameEn` of the Category the Item points to, active or inactive (ADR-CAT-075). An Item listed with `isActiveFl=false`, or the Entry of an inactive Item, can point to a Category that was deactivated after it (RULE-CAT-025 allows that); its label still shows, read-only, until the user chooses an active Category (AC-CAT-142). The separate whole-tree label read (CATEGORY-LABEL-QUERY of earlier revisions) is dropped: a user whose role cannot read the Category tree (`API-CAT-039` answers CAT-403-FORBIDDEN) still sees the Category's name, and only the selection field and the filter are hidden (ADR-CAT-051 as amended).

#### ATTRIBUTE-OPTIONS-QUERY — API-CAT-041            traces=API-CAT-041,REQ-CAT-014,REQ-CAT-044,REQ-CAT-047,REQ-CAT-049
Read query feeding the Variant generation picker: active attributes with their active values, by sortOrder. It sends `isActiveFl=true`, which `API-CAT-041` applies to the attributes and to their values alike, so inactive attributes and values are not offered (REQ-CAT-044, REQ-CAT-047). Enabled only while `variants` is on and the picker is open.

#### COMPONENT-PICKER-ITEMS-QUERY / COMPONENT-PICKER-VARIANTS-QUERY — API-CAT-038, API-CAT-002            traces=API-CAT-038,API-CAT-002,REQ-CAT-020,REQ-CAT-060
The Bundle component picker searches active STANDARD Items. Expanding an Item reads it and offers its active Variants (`variants[]` with `isActiveFl`). A Variant already in `bundleLines` is disabled (RULE-CAT-019). Both stay inside PERM_CAT_ITEMS_VIEW (ADR-CAT-051 §3).

#### COMPONENT-VARIANT-LABEL-QUERY — API-CAT-007            traces=API-CAT-007,REQ-CAT-058
Labels each Bundle component line: `BundleComponentView` carries `componentVariantFk` and `componentVariantCode`, and this read adds the Variant nameAr / nameEn. One read per distinct `componentVariantFk`, cached by `variantPk`.

#### SCALE-AVAILABILITY-QUERY — API-CAT-045            traces=API-CAT-045,REQ-CAT-096
Offers barcode type SCALE in the barcode drawer only while at least one `scaleLabelLayouts[]` entry has `isActiveFl` true. The drawer also shows the expected length, from the active layouts' `scaleCodeLength` (RULE-CAT-033). It shares its key with SCR-CAT-006, so a layout saved there refreshes this read.

#### VARIANT-IMAGES-QUERY — API-CAT-044            traces=API-CAT-044,REQ-CAT-109
Read on expanding a Variant row: the images bound to that Variant, or the Item's unbound images, primary first. Thumbnails come through IMAGE-FILE-URL (UXD-CAT-003).

#### BARCODE-LOOKUP-QUERY — API-CAT-043            traces=API-CAT-043,REQ-CAT-086,REQ-CAT-090,REQ-CAT-097,REQ-CAT-100
Read run on submit of "Find by barcode" (Enter, or the scanner's suffix). A hit navigates to `/cat/items/:itemPk?variant=<variantPk>`. When `embeddedValue` is present, a notice shows "scan-weight" or "scan-price" (by `embeddedValueTypeCode`) with `uomCode`. A miss shows the routed text, the input keeps its value, and focus moves to the text filter ("search by name", RULE-CAT-047's next action).

#### CATALOGUE-SEARCH-QUERY — API-CAT-047            traces=API-CAT-047,REQ-CAT-125,REQ-CAT-126,REQ-CAT-127
Exported by the Items module as the catalogue provider of the shell's global search (ADR-CAT-043, ADR-CAT-051 §2). It is enabled only for terms of at least 2 characters; a shorter term shows RULE-CAT-046's text and sends nothing. Hits keep the server order (exact code or barcode first, at most 20). A hit opens `/cat/items/:itemPk`. A user without PERM_CAT_ITEMS_VIEW gets an empty list from the server (REQ-CAT-127). The provider registers only when the user holds that permission, so the shell shows no catalogue group otherwise.

#### ITEM-SAVE — API-CAT-001 … API-CAT-019            traces=API-CAT-001,API-CAT-003,API-CAT-017,API-CAT-016,API-CAT-020,API-CAT-009,API-CAT-013,API-CAT-010,API-CAT-012,API-CAT-006,API-CAT-008,API-CAT-014,API-CAT-015,API-CAT-018,API-CAT-019,REQ-CAT-004,REQ-CAT-024,REQ-CAT-025,REQ-CAT-049,REQ-CAT-140,REQ-CAT-141,REQ-CAT-145,REQ-CAT-146,REQ-CAT-147,REQ-CAT-056,REQ-CAT-057,REQ-CAT-077,REQ-CAT-083,REQ-CAT-084,REQ-CAT-105,REQ-CAT-118
Mutation, the screen's ONE Save (ADR-CAT-049). On an inactive Item only three parts can be pending — the Category (step 1, `API-CAT-003` with every other header field unchanged), the Bundle components (step 2) and a Variant generation (step 5) — because the Entry offers no other input there (F3, ADR-CAT-068). The calls are ORDERED: each is sent only after the previous succeeded, and a part whose lines are unchanged is not sent at all:
1. `API-CAT-001` (new Item; `bundleComponents` = `bundleLines`, or `[]` for STANDARD) or `API-CAT-003` (dirty header; carries `version`).
2. `API-CAT-017`: update of a BUNDLE Item whose `bundleLines` differ from the last read. It carries the Item `version` returned by step 1, or by the last read when step 1 was skipped.
3. Deactivations: barcodes `API-CAT-016` → images `API-CAT-020` → Variants `API-CAT-009` → Item units `API-CAT-013`.
4. Item units: adds `API-CAT-010`, then flag changes `API-CAT-012` (with `version`).
5. Variant generation `API-CAT-006` (when `generation` is set). The success envelope's `CAT-201-EXISTING-VARIANTS-KEPT` shows RULE-CAT-012's text.
6. Variant e-invoice overrides `API-CAT-008` (with each Variant's `version`).
7. Barcodes on saved Variants: `API-CAT-014` (GTIN / SCALE), `API-CAT-015` (internal).
8. Images: for each new image, the file is first uploaded through the given FILE client (GIVEN-FILE-UPLOAD, to the FILE category `CAT_ITEM_IMAGE` — public, PNG / JPEG / WEBP, ≤ 5 MB — ADR-CAT-056, ADR-CAT-076), then `API-CAT-018` is sent with the returned `fileDocumentRef`; then changes `API-CAT-019` (with `version`). A FILE upload rejection stops the sequence like a CAT rejection. The success code `CAT-200-PRIMARY-IMAGE-REPLACED` shows RULE-CAT-039's text.

After the last call, or at the first rejection, the Item is re-read and the pending lines that were not sent stay pending. The rejected line is marked `failed` with its routed text, and the "partial-save" copy is shown when any call before it succeeded. A new Item that is rejected after step 1 is replaced by `/cat/items/:itemPk`.

Errors (text = the RULE message in ar/en as the envelope carries it):
- `CAT-422-NAME-AR-INVALID` → inline on header nameAr, or on the image line's nameAr; text: RULE-CAT-001 message (SRS)
- `CAT-422-NAME-EN-TOO-LONG` → inline on nameEn (header or image line); text: RULE-CAT-002 message
- `CAT-409-ITEM-NAME-DUPLICATE` → inline on nameAr; text: RULE-CAT-003 message, whose {code} the server fills with the existing Item's code; action "Open the existing item" → `/cat/items?text=<code>&isActiveFl=true`, which lists exactly that Item. `<code>` is the one token of the envelope's messageEn that matches the CAT_ITEM code pattern (`ITM-` + 6 digits, D-11); when no token matches (a tenant changed the series pattern), the action falls back to `/cat/items?text=<nameAr>&isActiveFl=true`
- `CAT-422-CODE-SYSTEM-ASSIGNED` → form banner; text: RULE-CAT-004 message (the UI never sends a code; seeing it is a defect)
- `CAT-500-CODE-NOT-ISSUED` → form banner with Try again; text: RULE-CAT-005 message
- `CAT-422-LOOKUP-VALUE-INACTIVE` → inline on every lookup field changed in the rejected call, and the lookups are re-read; text: RULE-CAT-006 message
- `CAT-422-BASE-UOM-FIXED` / `CAT-422-ITEM-KIND-FIXED` → form banner; text: RULE-CAT-007 / RULE-CAT-022 message
- `CAT-422-CAPABILITY-OFF` → banner on the flag-bound pane, and the flags are re-read; text: RULE-CAT-008 message
- `CAT-500-CAPABILITY-UNREADABLE` → form banner with Try again; text: RULE-CAT-009 message
- `CAT-409-VARIANT-COMBINATION-DUPLICATE` → on the generation summary row; text: RULE-CAT-013 message
- `CAT-422-VARIANT-LIMIT-EXCEEDED` → on the generation summary row; text: RULE-CAT-014 message
- `CAT-422-BUNDLE-SINGLE-VARIANT` → on the generation summary row; text: RULE-CAT-020 message
- `CAT-422-VARIANT-ATTRIBUTE-MISSING` → on the generation summary row; text: RULE-CAT-052 message
- `CAT-409-LAST-ACTIVE-VARIANT` → on the Variant line; text: RULE-CAT-015 message
- `CAT-409-VARIANT-IN-ACTIVE-BUNDLE` → on the Variant line; text: RULE-CAT-021 message
- `CAT-422-BUNDLE-COMPONENTS-REQUIRED` → on the Bundle components pane; text: RULE-CAT-018 message
- `CAT-422-BUNDLE-COMPONENT-INVALID` → on the Bundle components pane; text: RULE-CAT-019 message
- `CAT-422-CATEGORY-INACTIVE` → inline on categoryFk, and the Category options are re-read; text: RULE-CAT-026 message
- `CAT-422-EINVOICE-CODE-INVALID` → inline on einvoiceCode (header, or the override line); text: RULE-CAT-042 message
- `CAT-422-ITEM-UNIT-INVALID` → on the unit line; text: RULE-CAT-027 message
- `CAT-422-CONVERSION-FACTOR-FIXED` → on the unit line; text: RULE-CAT-028 message
- `CAT-409-ITEM-UNIT-HAS-BARCODES` → on the unit line marked for deactivation; the line returns to active with the failed mark; text: RULE-CAT-051 message (the server fills {count})
- `CAT-409-BARCODE-DUPLICATE` → inline on barcodeValue; text: RULE-CAT-029 message (the server fills {code})
- `CAT-422-GTIN-INVALID` → inline on barcodeValue; text: RULE-CAT-030 message
- `CAT-422-BARCODE-UNIT-INVALID` → inline on the barcode uomCode; text: RULE-CAT-031 message
- `CAT-409-BARCODE-SCALE-PREFIX` → inline on barcodeValue; text: RULE-CAT-032 message
- `CAT-422-SCALE-CODE-LENGTH` → inline on barcodeValue; text: RULE-CAT-033 message
- `CAT-422-IMAGE-NOT-ACCEPTED` (a 21st active image) → inline on the image file; text: RULE-CAT-038 message · a rejection of the given FILE upload to the category `CAT_ITEM_IMAGE` (wrong type, above 5 MB — the file part of RULE-CAT-038, ADR-CAT-076) → the same place, showing the FILE envelope's messageAr / messageEn; the line is marked `failed` and no request goes to `API-CAT-018` for it
- `CAT-422-MEDIA-VARIANT-MISMATCH` → inline on the image variantFk; text: RULE-CAT-040 message
- `CAT-409-STALE-VERSION` → form banner "stale-version" + Reload (pending lines kept); text: catalogue CAT-409-STALE-VERSION
- `CAT-500-CHANGE-NOT-SAVED` → form banner with Try again; text: RULE-CAT-049 message
- `CAT-404-NOT-FOUND` → the line is dropped and the Item re-read; generic text
- `CAT-422-PARENT-INACTIVE` → form banner, and the Item is re-read, so the Entry turns to its inactive mode (read-only except the three repairs — F3); text: RULE-CAT-053 message
- unauthenticated → login · forbidden → unauthorized view · server → generic

Invalidation on success: `[cat, items, detail, itemPk]`, `[cat, items, search]`, `[cat, variants, detail]` (this Item's Variants), `[cat, variants, media]`, `[cat, variants, search]`, `[cat, categories, items]`, `[cat, catalogue-search]`.

#### ITEM-STATE-COMMAND — API-CAT-004, API-CAT-005            traces=API-CAT-004,API-CAT-005,REQ-CAT-130,REQ-CAT-142,REQ-CAT-143,REQ-CAT-144,REQ-CAT-005,REQ-CAT-006,REQ-CAT-062,REQ-CAT-113,REQ-CAT-114,REQ-CAT-116
Mutation, a record command outside the form, enabled only when the form has no pending change. Deactivate → `API-CAT-004`. Reactivate → `API-CAT-005` `{isActiveFl: true}`. Publish / Unpublish → `API-CAT-005` `{publishStateCode: PUBLISHED | UNPUBLISHED}` — exactly one property per request (ADR-CAT-048).

Errors:
- `CAT-422-PUBLISH-BLOCKED` → command banner; text: RULE-CAT-041 message
- `CAT-409-VARIANT-IN-ACTIVE-BUNDLE` → command banner; text: RULE-CAT-021 message
- `CAT-409-ITEM-NAME-DUPLICATE` (reactivate) → command banner; text: RULE-CAT-003 message (the server fills {code} with the code of the other active Item); action "Open the existing item" → `/cat/items?text=<code>&isActiveFl=true`, `<code>` taken from the message as in ITEM-SAVE — the repair is to rename or deactivate that Item, since the inactive Item's own name cannot change (AC-CAT-162)
- `CAT-422-LOOKUP-VALUE-INACTIVE` (reactivate) → command banner; text: RULE-CAT-006 message
- `CAT-422-ITEM-NO-ACTIVE-VARIANT` (reactivate) → command banner; text: RULE-CAT-050 message; action "Generate variants" opens `?picker=variant-generation` while `variants` is on (the repair of ADR-CAT-068); while it is off, the action is absent and the banner keeps the message's other next action (create a new Item)
- `CAT-422-CATEGORY-INACTIVE` (reactivate) → command banner, and the Category field is highlighted and focused; text: RULE-CAT-026 message; action "Choose a category" focuses the Category field (a categoryFk-only Save is the repair — ADR-CAT-068), and, with PERM_CAT_CATEGORIES_VIEW, a second action "Open the category" → `/cat/categories?node=<categoryFk>`, where it can be reactivated (ADR-CAT-069)
- `CAT-422-BUNDLE-COMPONENT-INVALID` (reactivate) → command banner on the Bundle components pane; text: RULE-CAT-019 message; action "Edit components" opens `?picker=bundle-components` while `bundles` is on (the repair of ADR-CAT-068)
- `CAT-500-CHANGE-NOT-SAVED` → banner; text: RULE-CAT-049 message
- the success code `CAT-200-DEACTIVATED` → notice; text: RULE-CAT-048 message

Invalidation: `[cat, items, detail, itemPk]`, `[cat, items, search]`, `[cat, categories, items]`, `[cat, catalogue-search]`.

#### ITEM-SCREEN-INIT — SCR-CAT-001
Permission read: PERM_CAT_ITEMS_VIEW / CREATE / UPDATE / DELETE, from the platform session. Lookups used: CAT_BRAND, CAT_UOM, CAT_TAX_CLASS, CAT_ITEM_KIND, CAT_PUBLISH_STATE, CAT_EINVOICE_ITEM_CODE_TYPE, CAT_BARCODE_TYPE. Flags: CAPABILITY-FLAGS-INIT. Entity by id when editing: ITEM-QUERY. A new Item starts with `baseUomCode` PIECE, `taxClassCode` STANDARD, `itemKindCode` STANDARD (REQ-CAT-024, AC-CAT-027).

#### ITEM-FACADE — SCR-CAT-001
It composes the queries above. The state it owns:
- the search filters from the URL, including page and size;
- the selected Variant (`?variant=`);
- the react-hook-form instance of `ItemForm`, with the pending lines;
- the open drawer and picker, from the URL;
- derived flags: `isDirty`, `canCommand` (= not dirty), `showVariants` (= `variants` on), `showBundle` (= `bundles` on and kind BUNDLE), `showKind` (= `bundles` on), `scaleOffered`;
- derived loading.

Imperative operations: `save()` (ITEM-SAVE), `deactivate()` / `reactivate()` / `publish()` / `unpublish()` (ITEM-STATE-COMMAND, each after a confirmation), `addLine(kind, value)` / `markDeactivate(kind, id)` (form state only), `applyGeneration(selection)` / `applyComponents(variants)` (from the second levels), `findByBarcode(value)`.
<!-- SUB:F2-SCR-CAT-001:END -->

#### CATEGORY-TREE-QUERY / PARENT-OPTIONS-QUERY — API-CAT-039            traces=API-CAT-039,REQ-CAT-067,REQ-CAT-069
The tree view reads with the screen filters. The parent select reads active nodes only, and disables the node being edited and its descendants (computed from the `children` of the tree read — RULE-CAT-023). Depth is computed from the same tree to warn before save.

#### CATEGORY-QUERY — API-CAT-022            traces=API-CAT-022,REQ-CAT-066,REQ-CAT-067
Entity by id for the entry drawer (`?node=<categoryPk>`): it supplies the `version` and fresh values. A deactivated Category stays readable (REQ-CAT-066).

#### CATEGORY-ITEMS-QUERY — API-CAT-040            traces=API-CAT-040,REQ-CAT-068
Feeds the "Items of this category" summary row (total count + 3 names from page 0) and the second-level list (paged). A row jump seeds `/cat/items/:itemPk`, which identifies one Item.

#### CATEGORY-SAVE — API-CAT-021, API-CAT-023            traces=API-CAT-021,API-CAT-023,REQ-CAT-064,REQ-CAT-065,REQ-CAT-069,REQ-CAT-070
Mutation, the drawer's one Save: create (`API-CAT-021`) or update (`API-CAT-023`, with `version`, without `code`). Errors:
- `CAT-422-NAME-AR-INVALID` → inline on nameAr; text: RULE-CAT-001 message
- `CAT-422-NAME-EN-TOO-LONG` → inline on nameEn; text: RULE-CAT-002 message
- `CAT-422-CATEGORY-PARENT-INVALID` → inline on parentCategoryFk; text: RULE-CAT-023 message
- `CAT-409-CATEGORY-DUPLICATE` → inline on code (create) and nameAr; text: RULE-CAT-024 message
- `CAT-409-STALE-VERSION` → drawer banner + Reload; text: catalogue CAT-409-STALE-VERSION
- other → as §3.0

#### CATEGORY-DEACTIVATE — API-CAT-024            traces=API-CAT-024,REQ-CAT-066,REQ-CAT-071
Record command in the drawer, after a confirmation. The success code `CAT-200-DEACTIVATED` → notice, text: RULE-CAT-048 message.

#### CATEGORY-REACTIVATE — API-CAT-053            traces=API-CAT-053,REQ-CAT-136
Record command in the drawer of an inactive Category, after a confirmation, only while the drawer has no pending change; it sends `{isActiveFl: true}` (ADR-CAT-069). Errors:
- `CAT-422-CATEGORY-PARENT-INVALID` → drawer banner; text: RULE-CAT-023 message; action "Open the parent" → `?node=<parentCategoryFk>`, where the parent can be reactivated first
- `CAT-409-CATEGORY-DUPLICATE` → drawer banner and inline on nameAr; text: RULE-CAT-024 message (rename it first, then reactivate)
- other → as §3.0

#### CATEGORY-SCREEN-INIT — SCR-CAT-002
Permission read PERM_CAT_CATEGORIES_VIEW / CREATE / UPDATE / DELETE; no lookups; entity by id: CATEGORY-QUERY. A new node takes `?parent=` as its parent.

#### CATEGORY-FACADE — SCR-CAT-002
It owns: the tree filters (URL); the open node (`?node=`) and `items=open`; the drawer form; the Items-of-category paging inside its filter object; derived loading. Operations: `save()`, `deactivate()`, `reactivate()`, `openItems()`, `openDirectItems()` ("Items directly in this category" → `/cat/items?categoryFk=<categoryPk>`; API-CAT-038 filters on the Category itself, not on its sub-categories, unlike the sub-tree count of CATEGORY-ITEMS-QUERY — so the jump carries its own label).
<!-- SUB:F2-SCR-CAT-002:END -->

### F2 · SCR-CAT-003 — Variant attributes

```yaml name=screen-hooks
screen: SCR-CAT-003
hooks:
  - {hook: ATTRIBUTE-LIST-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-CAT-041], cache_key: "[cat, variant-attributes, list, {text, isActiveFl}]", errors: "CAT-403 → unauthorized · other → generic (the read is not flag-bound; while `variants` is off the screen sends nothing — UXD-CAT-002)", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: ATTRIBUTE-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-CAT-026], cache_key: "[cat, variant-attributes, detail, variantAttributePk]", errors: "CAT-404-NOT-FOUND → drawer closes, not-found notice · other → generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: CAPABILITY-FLAGS-INIT, kind: init, cache_key: "[platform, app-config]", errors: "unreadable → screen state with RULE-CAT-009 text", loading: NONE}
  - {hook: ATTRIBUTE-SCREEN-INIT, kind: init, cache_key: "—", errors: "no VIEW → unauthorized · variants off → RULE-CAT-008 state", loading: NONE}
  - {hook: ATTRIBUTE-SAVE, kind: mutation, api: [API-CAT-025, API-CAT-027, API-CAT-031, API-CAT-055, API-CAT-029, API-CAT-030], errors: "see ATTRIBUTE-SAVE below", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "[cat, variant-attributes, list] · [cat, variant-attributes, detail, variantAttributePk] · [cat, items, detail] · [cat, variants, detail]"}
  - {hook: ATTRIBUTE-DEACTIVATE, kind: mutation, api: [API-CAT-028], errors: "CAT-409-ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-IN-USE → drawer banner, text RULE-CAT-017 message", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "[cat, variant-attributes, list] · [cat, variant-attributes, detail, variantAttributePk]"}
  - {hook: ATTRIBUTE-REACTIVATE, kind: mutation, api: [API-CAT-054], errors: "CAT-409-ATTRIBUTE-CODE-NAME-DUPLICATE → drawer banner and inline on nameAr, text RULE-CAT-016 message · other → as §3.0", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "[cat, variant-attributes, list] · [cat, variant-attributes, detail, variantAttributePk]"}
  - {hook: ATTRIBUTE-FACADE, kind: facade}
```

#### ATTRIBUTE-LIST-QUERY — API-CAT-041            traces=API-CAT-041,REQ-CAT-048,REQ-CAT-014
The list by sortOrder, each attribute with its values. It sends no `isActiveFl` filter by default (the Active filter starts empty), so `API-CAT-041` returns every attribute with every value, active and inactive, and inactive ones stay visible and can be reactivated (API-CAT-054, 055). When the user sets the Active filter, it filters the values as well as the attributes. Enabled only while `variants` is on (UXD-CAT-002); while it is off, the screen shows RULE-CAT-008's text and sends nothing.

#### ATTRIBUTE-QUERY — API-CAT-026            traces=API-CAT-026,REQ-CAT-048
Entity by id for the entry drawer: the attribute's `version` and its values with their `version`s seed the form. `API-CAT-026` takes no filter and returns every value of the attribute, active and inactive, so the values editor sends no filter and shows inactive values with their Reactivate action (REQ-CAT-138).

#### ATTRIBUTE-SAVE — API-CAT-025 … API-CAT-031, API-CAT-055            traces=API-CAT-025,API-CAT-027,API-CAT-029,API-CAT-030,API-CAT-031,API-CAT-055,REQ-CAT-042,REQ-CAT-043,REQ-CAT-045,REQ-CAT-046,REQ-CAT-047,REQ-CAT-054,REQ-CAT-055,REQ-CAT-138
Mutation, the drawer's ONE Save. The calls are ORDERED, and each is sent only after the previous succeeded:
1. `API-CAT-025` (new attribute) or `API-CAT-027` (dirty header, with `version`).
2. Value deactivations `API-CAT-031`. They go first, so that a nameAr freed among the active values can be reused (RULE-CAT-016).
3. Value reactivations `API-CAT-055` (lines marked `reactivate`, ADR-CAT-069), after the deactivations for the same reason.
4. Value creates `API-CAT-029` under the attribute's pk returned by step 1, or the existing pk.
5. Value changes `API-CAT-030` (with `version`).

The value calls are not sent at all when the value set is unchanged. At the first rejection the sequence stops: the attribute is re-read, the unsent values stay pending, the failed line is marked, and the "partial-save" copy is shown when an earlier call succeeded.

Errors:
- `CAT-422-NAME-AR-INVALID` → inline on nameAr (attribute or value line); text: RULE-CAT-001 message
- `CAT-422-NAME-EN-TOO-LONG` → inline on nameEn; text: RULE-CAT-002 message
- `CAT-409-ATTRIBUTE-CODE-NAME-DUPLICATE` → inline on code and nameAr of the attribute or value line; text: RULE-CAT-016 message
- `CAT-409-ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-IN-USE` → on the value line; text: RULE-CAT-017 message (the server fills {count})
- `CAT-422-CAPABILITY-OFF` → drawer banner, and the flags are re-read; text: RULE-CAT-008 message
- `CAT-500-CAPABILITY-UNREADABLE` → drawer banner; text: RULE-CAT-009 message
- `CAT-409-STALE-VERSION` → drawer banner + Reload; text: catalogue CAT-409-STALE-VERSION

Invalidation includes the Item reads, because derived Variant names change with the value names (AC-CAT-045, AC-CAT-048).

#### ATTRIBUTE-DEACTIVATE — API-CAT-028            traces=API-CAT-028,REQ-CAT-044,REQ-CAT-054
Record command in the drawer, after a confirmation, only while the drawer has no pending change.

#### ATTRIBUTE-REACTIVATE — API-CAT-054            traces=API-CAT-054,REQ-CAT-137
Record command in the drawer of an inactive attribute, after a confirmation, only while the drawer has no pending change; it sends `{isActiveFl: true}`. Its values keep their own state: an inactive value line offers "Reactivate", which marks it `reactivate` for the next Save (ATTRIBUTE-SAVE step 3 — ADR-CAT-069).

#### ATTRIBUTE-SCREEN-INIT — SCR-CAT-003
Permission read PERM_CAT_VARIANT_ATTRIBUTES_VIEW / CREATE / UPDATE / DELETE; the `variants` flag (UXD-CAT-002); no lookups; entity by id: ATTRIBUTE-QUERY. `returnTo` is kept to go back to the Items Entry after Save.

#### ATTRIBUTE-FACADE — SCR-CAT-003
It owns: the list filters (URL); the open attribute (`?attribute=`) and `values=open`; the drawer form with the value lines; derived loading. Operations: `save()`, `deactivate()`, `reactivate()`, `applyValues(set)` (from the second level, form state only).
<!-- SUB:F2-SCR-CAT-003:END -->

### F2 · SCR-CAT-004 — Item import

```yaml name=screen-hooks
screen: SCR-CAT-004
hooks:
  - {hook: IMPORT-SHEET-DOWNLOAD, kind: read, api: [API-CAT-048], cache_key: "none — a file download, not cached", errors: "CAT-403 → unauthorized · other → generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: IMPORT-SCREEN-INIT, kind: init, cache_key: "—", errors: "no VIEW → unauthorized", loading: NONE}
  - {hook: GIVEN-FILE-UPLOAD, kind: mutation, cache_key: "—", errors: "rejection of the given FILE upload → inline on the file input, the FILE envelope's messageAr / messageEn", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: IMPORT-SUBMIT, kind: mutation, api: [API-CAT-049], errors: "see IMPORT-SUBMIT below", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "[cat, items, search] · [cat, catalogue-search] · [cat, categories, items]"}
  - {hook: IMPORT-FACADE, kind: facade}
```

#### IMPORT-SHEET-DOWNLOAD — API-CAT-048            traces=API-CAT-048,REQ-CAT-036
Read on click. The binary body is saved as a file named after the import sheet.

#### IMPORT-SUBMIT — API-CAT-049            traces=API-CAT-049,REQ-CAT-037,REQ-CAT-038,REQ-CAT-039,REQ-CAT-040,REQ-CAT-041,REQ-CAT-139
Mutation, the screen's one submit. The chosen file is first uploaded through the given FILE client (GIVEN-FILE-UPLOAD, private storage — ADR-CAT-056), then `API-CAT-049` is sent with `{fileDocumentRef}`. The response `ImportResult` fills the result view. Errors and notices:
- `CAT-422-IMPORT-FILE-REJECTED` → inline on the file input; text: RULE-CAT-044 message
- a rejection of the given FILE upload → inline on the file input, showing the FILE envelope's messageAr / messageEn
- `CAT-404-NOT-FOUND` (the uploaded file is no longer available) → inline on the file input; generic text, and the file is uploaded again on the next Import
- the success code `CAT-200-IMPORT-ROW-REJECTED` → result list; each rejected row shows its `messageAr` / `messageEn` (RULE-CAT-045 message filled per row)
- `CAT-500-CODE-NOT-ISSUED` → banner with Try again; text: RULE-CAT-005 message (the whole import was rolled back — ADR-CAT-048 §3)
- `CAT-500-CHANGE-NOT-SAVED` → banner; text: RULE-CAT-049 message (also the answer when the import passed its 120-second limit and was rolled back whole — REQ-CAT-139, ADR-CAT-071; no Item was created, and the owner imports the file again, split into smaller files)

#### IMPORT-SCREEN-INIT — SCR-CAT-004
Permission read PERM_CAT_ITEM_IMPORT_VIEW / CREATE; no lookups; no entity. When mounted by the setup wizard, the wizard's "next" stays the wizard's control; this screen exposes `onImported(result)`.

#### IMPORT-FACADE — SCR-CAT-004
It owns: the chosen file, the import phase, the last result. Operations: `downloadSheet()`, `import()`, `reset()`.
<!-- SUB:F2-SCR-CAT-004:END -->

#### VARIANT-SEARCH-QUERY — API-CAT-042            traces=API-CAT-042,REQ-CAT-101
Feeds the Variant picker: active Variants by code, name or barcode, paged. Each row carries `itemNameAr` and `firstBarcodeValue` (empty when none).

#### SEEDED-VARIANT-QUERY — API-CAT-007            traces=API-CAT-007,REQ-CAT-101
Runs once when the route carries `?variantPk=`. It adds that one Variant as a line, with the earliest-created active barcode from `barcodes[]`.

#### LABEL-PRINT — API-CAT-050            traces=API-CAT-050,REQ-CAT-102,REQ-CAT-103,REQ-CAT-104
Mutation, the screen's one submit. It sends `{lines: [{variantPk, copies}]}`, and the PDF body opens in a new tab. Errors:

- `CAT-404-NOT-FOUND` → lines no longer found are flagged `not-found`; generic text

#### SETTINGS-QUERY — API-CAT-045            traces=API-CAT-045,REQ-CAT-095
Both lists in full, each entry with its active state. Each drawer edits a list entry (there is no read-by-id operation for these records), taking `version` from the list. A Unit e-invoice code row is labelled by the CAT_UOM lookup of its `key`, and by `valueAr` / `valueEn` when present.

## F3 — Forms & Validators

Forms use `react-hook-form` with a `zod` resolver per form. A client validator mirrors a RULE only where the client holds every input the rule needs. Its message is that RULE's message (SRS), in ar and en, by reference; the client fills a placeholder only when it knows the value. The server stays authoritative, and its codes are mapped back to the same fields (F2). A limit with no RULE (a maximum length from the document) is enforced by the input's `maxLength`, not by a message. A field the server fixes after first save is rendered read-only, not validated.
